t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup styled as a warm limestone paper drawing sheet with a fine navy border. Top-left: a small sans eyebrow and a two-line large light-weight navy sans-serif headline in sentence case. Below, three columns of short entries separated by vertical hairlines, each entry followed by a tiny navy and steel-blue hairline glyph, listing <CONTENT>. A narrow right column holds numbered mono notes. Bottom-right: a drawing title block with fine grid cells and a wordmark. Flat, square corners, no shading, calm and precise.
signature_idea: A process, control and record list set on a limestone drawing sheet, each entry tagged with a tiny hairline glyph like a drawing symbol.
strengths: limestone sheet, navy linework and a light headline are on-brand and calm
three parallel columns read process to control to record cleanly
entry type is large and readable with good spacing
title block and notes column give engineering character cheaply
weaknesses: prompt words leak in as text: 'award-winning web design', 'Numbered notes', 'Drawing sheet title block'
glyphs are abstract and mean nothing; they do not depict any record type
notes column is mostly empty numbers
rows do not align across columns and the last row has no matching entries
title block cells are empty filler
brand_fit_why: Limestone sheet, navy hairlines, light headline, mono notes and square corners fit, but leaked prompt text and meaningless glyphs undercut precision.
